name: Belmond Hotel Caruso
insider_take: This 11th-century palace turned luxury hotel literally hangs on a cliff 1,000 feet above the Mediterranean, offering the most dramatic infinity pool views on the entire Amalfi Coast.
whats_special: Built into the ancient clifftop town of Ravello, Hotel Caruso occupies a former palace where noble families once entertained. The hotel's infinity pool appears to merge seamlessly with the azure sea below, while terraced gardens cascade down the mountainside. Wagner composed parts of Parsifal here, and the hotel's concert pavilion still hosts world-class performances against the backdrop of the Tyrrhenian Sea.
pro_tip: Book the Belvedere Suite for exclusive access to a private terrace that juts out over the cliff edge - it's where Greta Garbo used to retreat for ultimate privacy during her stays.
dont_miss: The sunset aperitivo ritual at the pool terrace, where champagne is served as the sun melts into the Mediterranean horizon. Also explore Villa Rufolo's gardens next door - the very spot that inspired Wagner's magical garden scene in Parsifal, just a two-minute walk from your room.
pros: Breathtaking clifftop location with panoramic Amalfi Coast views
Stunning infinity pool carved into the cliff face
Luxurious accommodations in an 11th-century palazzo setting
Exceptional fine dining with Michelin-starred cuisine
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive positioning
Clifftop location requires walking on steep terrain
